audience: online sellers who sell printed tees and hoodies made by Tshirtgang

useCases.title: Check blanks, colours and sizes
useCases.text: List the blank styles, colours and sizes with their stock. Narrow the list by style or colour.

useCases.title: Estimate production time
useCases.text: Get the production time in business days for a style, to tell a buyer when the order ships.

useCases.title: Review orders
useCases.text: List your orders with their status, recipient, item and tracking. Filter by order number or status.

useCases.title: Create a product from a design
useCases.text: Create a catalogue product from a public HTTPS PNG design, for every size of one style and colour.

useCases.title: Place an order for a recipient
useCases.text: After you confirm the recipient and quantities, place a paid order from a product id. It ships to a real person.
